entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.code_description: Ozone therapy, oxygen therapy, aerosol therapy, artificial respiration or other therapeutic respiration apparatus
entries.comment:
Certain medical devices intended only for individual use by persons with functional body disorders. 
(Section 42, Paragraph 2 of the Law; https://likumi.lv/ta/en/en/id/253451)

entries.category_description: Pharmaceutical products of a kind normally used for health care, prevention of illness and as treatment for medical and veterinary purposes, including products used for contraception and sanitary protection
entries.code_description: Ozone therapy, oxygen therapy, aerosol therapy, artificial respiration or other therapeutic respiration apparatus
entries.comment: Tabel I prov. a.6: medicines as referred to in article 1-1-B of the 'Geneesmiddelenwet' (Dutch 'Medicine Act') for which a marketing authorization as referred to in article 1, section III of that act has been granted or for which a marketing authorization is not required pursuant to article 40-3-A to G of that act; contraceptives; infusion fluids; kidney dialyses concentrates; and inhalation gases apparently intended for medical purposes.

entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.code_description: Ozone therapy, oxygen therapy, aerosol therapy, artificial respiration or other therapeutic respiration apparatus
entries.comment: Tabel I prov. a.37 and b.1: measuring equipment and accessories for self-diagnosis of the coagulation time of blood; drug nebulizers; catheters; urine bags; allergen-free covers; anti-decubitus mattresses; portable infusion pumps; oxygen concentrates and accessories, and carrying straps or bags specially designed for personal mobile use for an oxygen cylinder or oxygen container; computer mouse software, whether or not supplied by electronic means, specially developed for users with tremor.

entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.code_description: Ozone therapy, oxygen therapy, aerosol therapy, artificial respiration or other therapeutic respiration apparatus
entries.comment: Supply of prostheses and their accessories, with the exception of dental prostheses exempt from tax under art.292 para.(1) lett.(b) and supply of orthopedic products. When those goods are imported from a third territory or a third country, the reduced VAT rate is conditioned by submission of the Customs Notice for medical devices or the Declaration of conformity of the medical device manufacturer according to art.12 of the Order no.1009/2016. Art.294 para.(5) letters c), d) of the Fiscal Code.
